evals.name: branch-commit-mr
evals.prompt: 별도 브랜치에 커밋 푸시후 MR 생성. 노드 잦은 교체로 파드 재시작이 많아서 consolidation 완화하는 작업이야.
evals.expected_output: Creates `<type>/<kebab>` branch from default branch; stages only the task file (no `git add -A`, unrelated WIP untouched); commit `type(scope): subject` in the language of recent log; no attribution trailers; `glab mr create --remove-source-branch --yes`; body has 진행배경 (with the user's stated reason), 변경사항, 기타사항, each 1 to 3 bullets; reports full MR URL.

evals.name: mr-update-shrink
evals.prompt: 커밋 푸시하고 MR 업데이트. MR 분량 50%로 축소
evals.expected_output: Fetches current remote description first; keeps user-added screenshot and lines; adds the new change; rewrites to about half length keeping the three sections; uses `glab mr update`.

evals.name: commit-only
evals.expected_output: Commits staged task changes with repo convention; does not push or open an MR.
